'''Erio'anum''' was one of the [[Gods of Age]], a group of seventeen gods that were worshipped by the [[Fian/Legends|Fia]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Erio'anum was prayed to by Fia that were aged ninety-seven or over.<ref name="CCW" />
